logical_boundaries: The global period and curve arguments are written proofs,not machine-verified by the small checker.
A finite etale map preserves normalized h and reflects safety of each pulled-back phase;it does not automatically descend an arbitrary phase or reflect whole-model MZ.
The unary theorem requires normality,unirationality and only constant units;the intrinsic-period theorem itself permits nonconstant character units.
All regular rational unary descent is excluded for a noninvariant SL2 phase under perfect2I;orbit norms/averages involving several distinct orbit functions remain outside this barrier.
Aut-saturation and arbitrary algebraic Cstar contractions are sufficient safe classes;no claim that they exhaust pure-null functions.
Both all-degree exceptional MZ decisions remain OPEN;the all-pair nullcone classification is already internally closed.
